question: Design a fermenter for that simulated batch and tell me how many vessels and what working volume it needs.
gaps: No batch simulation is kept in fermOS. A read of the fermOS simulation rows returned none, so there is no simulated batch to design a fermenter for. Please run a batch simulation (fermOS → Simulate, or fermos_simulate with the batch family and the strain and sugar named) and tell me which artifact it produced.

The vessel design needs a kept simulation or kinetic fit artifact id. None exists, so the design was not attempted. A write attempt without an artifact id was refused, which asked for one kept simulation or fit id.
A kinetic fit or a forecast could serve as the basis instead of a simulation. fermOS holds no fit or forecast artifacts either, so the same gap applies.
I did not create a simulation myself, because the question refers to one that already exists and I have no parameters or records to bind it.
declined: The corpus holds no simulated batch to design a fermenter for. fermOS has no kept simulation, fit, forecast or vessel rows, and the plant scale that sets the vessel count and working volume is not on file.
rejectionReasons: a gap dropped: it holds a number
